name: attri-insurance
description: Attri for Insurance Agencies — AI workflows for submission triage, policy comparison, policyholder requests (FNOL, COI, endorsements), book-of-business renewal tracking, retention watch, and a Monday agency brief. Built on Anthropic's open-source Small Business plugin, customized for insurance. Every skill keeps an audit trail and requires human approval before anything is sent, filed, or submitted. Learn more at https://attri.ai.
